proposal.description: Copy-paste slip: the soft-start count takes its leaving bit from the run shift register, which is held clear during S_SS, instead of from the oldest bit of the soft-start window.
proposal.reason: In S_SS, faulted cycles that leave the 32-cycle window are never subtracted. Once a faulted cycle is more than 32 cycles old, fault_count_ss_out stays too high and window_trip_SS can assert even though the trailing window holds fewer than trip_ss faulted cycles.

proposal.description: While neither S_SS nor S_RUN is active, the blanking history is preloaded with the current comparator level instead of being cleared, so a CP flag that is high in idle or hiccup carries into the new attempt.
proposal.reason: Suppose cp_sync is high when the supervisor enters S_SS, for example after reset because the synchroniser resets high, or because the overcurrent persisted through hiccup. A pwm_rise within BLANK_CLKS clocks of entry then samples a faulted cycle that was never seen while switching, and fault_count_ss_out and window_trip_SS change.

proposal.description: The windows and counts are cleared when a window trip fires instead of whenever neither S_SS nor S_RUN is active.
proposal.reason: If S_RUN or S_SS is left without an overcurrent trip (g_en low, UVLO, OTP), the counts stay nonzero on fault_count_run_out and fault_count_ss_out through S_OFF, and the next soft start begins with the old history. On a trip, the counts are cleared one clock after it fires while the state is still active.

proposal.description: The current-protection flag is treated as active-low when it enters the blanking history, so a cycle with the comparator low is counted as faulted.
proposal.reason: While switching with CP_trig low, every switching cycle is logged as faulted, so the counts climb and window_trip_SS or window_trip fires. A real overcurrent (CP high) is logged as a clean cycle.

proposal.description: The S_RUN trip also fires when the soft-start count, which is held through S_RUN only for telemetry, is at or above trip_ss.
proposal.reason: In S_RUN with no run-window faults, suppose the held fault_count_ss is at or above trip_ss: it reached the threshold on the edge the FSM left S_SS, or TRIP_SS was lowered during S_RUN. window_trip then asserts and sends the supervisor to hiccup.

proposal.description: The run-count telemetry output reports the count of the present state, so outside S_RUN it shows the soft-start count instead of the run window's count.
proposal.reason: During S_SS, after faulted cycles have been sampled, fault_count_run_out shows the (truncated) soft-start count instead of 0, because the run window is held clear in S_SS.
